title: Progress and rewards
summary: XP for real effort, the day done, streaks with freezes, achievements and a daily reminder.
description: The rewards exist to make daily practice a habit, and they reward what was really done. Harder exercises pay more, wrong answers pay nothing, and cards that are only read pay close to nothing.

requirements.text: A wrong answer earns no XP.
XP per right answer depends on the kind of exercise: recognising among choices pays 6, typing or dictation 14, filling a gap 16; an item answered for the first time pays 2 more.
Extra practice on a lesson already passed today pays half XP.
A day is done when the day's lessons are all done and something was practised; on a day with no lessons to give, having practised at all.
A failed check-in or a quick game counts as having practised, even when it earned no XP.
The streak counts done days in a row and still shows as alive on the day after the last done day.
Every seventh day of a run earns a streak freeze; at most 2 are kept.
Missed days are covered by freezes automatically when there are enough freezes for all of them.
A word sticks once its review interval reaches 21 days.

Achievements are earned for done days and streaks (3, 7, 30 and 100 days), words met and words that stick, sentences, dialogues, check-ins, writing, listening, a first song, a lesson made by the tutor and a completed course.
An achievement's progress and its unlock come from the same count, so the number shown and the unlock always agree.

Reset progress erases reviews, days, the XP log, the mastery ledger, passes, mastery, streak freezes, achievements, check-ins and the tutor's conversations together; courses and their content are kept, closed courses stay closed, and the learning log is kept.
AI costs survive a reset of progress.
A reminder is scheduled once a day for the week ahead at a time the learner chooses; today's is skipped once the day is done.
Reminders are scheduled again on every launch.
The Progress screen shows stats, what has been met, achievements, XP by day, an 18-week activity map and vocabulary totals.
